comment: ANCHOR: ADVICE_DIGEST_CAUSE_20261104 — the OTHER UPDATES block renders the CAUSE it counted, not only the count: the most common non-empty title per report type, plus how many distinct causes were folded in beside it, and an explicit 'no cause recorded' rather than silence.
